title: Duke sent no flowers when Bigard's father died
summary: Duke collected money for flowers for friends' deaths but said nothing when Bigard's father died, which Bigard never forgave.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: But the thing that mostly when I got really disgusted with him -- see, he, every time somebody, a friend of his died, he'd go around to the guys and ask them if they want to donate a little money for flowers or something to send to this guy's wife, or if he was stranded, if you want to make a little pot to give him and let him go home. And when my father died, I was in Chicago, and he had met my father. I told him, I said, "Duke, my dad died," I said. So we got together and, he'd you know, "make -- send some flowers down there," you know. Nothing. He didn't say nothing like this -- everything -- that teed me off but good, because

if I could give money to friends of his, people that I don't know, and he knew my father and I'm working for him, you know, then I thought that he should reciprocate, in a way, that -- to try to help make me feel halfway good anyhow. So I didn't say no more about it, but I never did forgive him for it and I never did care for him anymore.
